title: Reports
subtitle: Review financial, occupancy, utility, and deposit performance.

financial.noData: No finalized invoices, cash payments, or owner expenses were recorded in {year}. Zero-value months are still shown for continuity.
financial.billedDefinition: Finalized invoice totals grouped by invoice billing period.
financial.collectedDefinition: Cash payments grouped by payment date. Deposit applications are excluded.
financial.expensesDefinition: Owner/property expenses grouped by expense date.
financial.netCashDefinition: Cash collected − owner expenses. This is not accounting profit.

revenue.noDataTitle: No finalized invoices in this view
revenue.noDataText: Try another year or search term.

expenses.noDataTitle: No expenses recorded in this view
expenses.noDataText: There are no owner costs matching these filters.

utilities.electricityHelper: Uses finalized Phase 3 electricity attribution. Vacant usage is not assigned to tenants.
utilities.waterHelper: Water is not represented as measured consumption; this follows the current fixed-per-occupant billing semantics.
utilities.noDataText: No finalized electricity usage is available for this year.

deposits.helper: Deposits remain separate from revenue. Expected and held are current positions; received, refunded, deductions, and applied values reflect the selected year.
deposits.noDataText: Deposit ledger activity will appear here when available.
